launch_options.name: Positive-price downloadable game
launch_options.seller_objective: Require a genuine payment for a downloadable game build
launch_options.strength: A sale requires positive payment and gives an attributable order record.
launch_options.drawback: A public game page is not necessarily indexed; the seller has to earn the buyer's attention and absorb transaction, production and support costs.

launch_options.name: Free HTML5 browser play with optional donation
launch_options.seller_objective: Maximize accessible play while allowing voluntary financial support
launch_options.strength: Accessible in browser without a mandatory price gate; compatible with jams or free discovery.
launch_options.drawback: Plays are not sales, and HTML5 embedded gameplay cannot be assumed to yield mandatory paid access.

launch_options.name: Free demo plus separately paid full downloadable game
launch_options.seller_objective: Let buyers sample a build before deciding whether to purchase the full game
launch_options.strength: Separates product evaluation from paid ownership.
launch_options.drawback: Costs more in packaging, support and evaluation; demo usage does not prove willingness to pay.

decision_tree.if: The game must require payment before full downloadable access
The game is designed only for free browser play with optional financial support
A demo can be maintained separately without consuming more resources than approved
No positive-price merchant eligibility is verified
Release has not been tested on the advertised platforms
No eligible buyer-count or representative paid game conversion data

readiness_gates.requires: Documented payment route accepted by provider for seller country and valid identity/tax onboarding
Executable/playable tested on target desktop/mobile platform, input, save behavior and patch path
Licenses for game code, art, assets, music and collaboration agreements
Published game indexed where eligible, honest tags and a documented launch/referral campaign
Explicit intended list price, true payment deductions, fixed cash costs, valued labor and necessary paid-order break-even
Consented aggregate counts for aligned impressions, plays, refunds, settled purchases and repeat paid orders

limitations: Practical launch routes follow operator-documented mechanics; no route is shown to be the highest-profit option.
Do not treat retrospective top-seller ranks, public impressions or games-with-ratings as a paid-success probability.
No actual game was built, tested or listed and no seller identity or financial information was accessed.
No purchase, account change, financial expense, marketing experiment, or additional specimen intake is authorized.
Development cash expenditure and labor opportunity cost remain separate and both must be reported.
